04 / GOOD TO KNOW

A little clarity
goes a long way.

A few answers before you take the next step.

Have a different question?
Which service is right for me?

It depends on your reason for coming to Vietnam and your current situation. Use the service finder above for a starting point, or speak with our team to review your options.

Can you help if I’m already in Vietnam?

Our services include visa extensions, work permit renewals and residence card support. Tell us about your current status and expiry date so the team can check the available options for your case.

What documents will I need?

The document list varies by service and individual circumstances. After reviewing your case, the team will explain what is needed, including any translation, notarization or legalization. Start with a description of your plans; you don’t need to upload documents here.

How much will it cost, and how long will it take?

Fees and timelines depend on the service, your circumstances and the documents available. We provide a detailed quotation before starting and discuss the expected process with you. Processing and final decisions remain with the relevant authorities.

Do you work with schools and employers?

Yes. Gary Agency and Visa Star World work with schools, language centers and businesses, supporting foreign teachers and other professionals with their applications and supporting documents.
